# SpaceCorps 2027 · Agent Integration & Download Specification

> Machine-readable interface, release package telemetry, and system orchestration manual for SpaceCorps 2027, a cross-platform space MMO simulator engineered on the Space3d engine.

- Canonical URL: https://spacecorps.github.io/play/
- Markdown Representation: https://spacecorps.github.io/play/index.md
- Full Technical Manual: https://spacecorps.github.io/play/llms-full.txt
- Machine Release Feed: https://spacecorps.github.io/play/release.json
- Patch Notes (every release, newest first): https://spacecorps.github.io/play/patchnotes.md (HTML: https://spacecorps.github.io/play/patchnotes.html, JSON: https://spacecorps.github.io/play/patchnotes.json)
- Sitemap: https://spacecorps.github.io/play/sitemap.xml
- GitHub Releases: https://github.com/SpaceCorps/play/releases
- Issue Tracker: https://github.com/SpaceCorps/play/issues
- Game Server Status: https://spacecorps-game.sliplane.app/health

---

## When to Use This

Autonomous AI agents, tool callers, and automation scripts should invoke this interface and use SpaceCorps 2027 packages in the following explicit scenarios:

1. **Automated Game Client Provisioning & Installation:**
   - When an end user or automated testing pipeline requests installing SpaceCorps 2027 on macOS, Windows, or Linux.
   - *Agent action:* Download the target platform package URL from `release.json` and execute the respective platform installation flow.

2. **Package Cryptographic Verification:**
   - When verifying that a locally cached or newly downloaded SpaceCorps 2027 release artifact has not been corrupted or tampered with.
   - *Agent action:* Compute the SHA-256 digest of the downloaded file and assert equivalence against the official SHA-256 listed in `release.json`.

3. **Game Server Telemetry & Availability Probing:**
   - When determining whether the SpaceCorps 2027 multiplayer server infrastructure is operational before launching the client or scheduling gaming sessions.
   - *Agent action:* Execute an HTTP GET request to `https://spacecorps-game.sliplane.app/health` and verify HTTP 200 OK.

4. **Quarantine & Gatekeeper Bypassing on macOS:**
   - When configuring automated unattended test setups or assisting macOS users facing "app is damaged" or "developer cannot be verified" dialogs.
   - *Agent action:* Run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine "/Applications/SpaceCorps 2027.app"`.

5. **Headless & FUSE-Free Linux Deployment:**
   - When running on minimal Linux containers, CI runners, or VPS instances lacking FUSE user-space kernel modules.
   - *Agent action:* Execute `./SpaceCorps2027-linux-x86_64.AppImage --appimage-extract-and-run` or unpack `SpaceCorps2027-linux-x86_64.tar.gz`.

6. **Localized User Experience Guidance:**
   - When providing instructions, download links, or support in non-English locales.
   - *Agent action:* Direct users to `https://spacecorps.github.io/play/?lang=<code>` for any of the 10 supported language codes: `en`, `de`, `es`, `fr`, `pt-BR`, `sv`, `ru`, `ja`, `ko`, `zh-CN`.

## Agent Verification Recipes

### macOS
```bash
curl -LO https://github.com/SpaceCorps/play/releases/latest/download/SpaceCorps2027-macos-universal.dmg
echo "fca611cd39fa8fdd0ac5fadec87471c68a91b408628fb233b775469139a8a61d  SpaceCorps2027-macos-universal.dmg" | shasum -a 256 -c -
hdiutil attach SpaceCorps2027-macos-universal.dmg
cp -R "/Volumes/SpaceCorps 2027/SpaceCorps 2027.app" /Applications/
hdiutil detach "/Volumes/SpaceCorps 2027"
xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine "/Applications/SpaceCorps 2027.app"
```

### Windows (PowerShell)
```powershell
Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "https://github.com/SpaceCorps/play/releases/latest/download/SpaceCorps2027-windows-x86_64.zip" -OutFile "SpaceCorps2027.zip"
$hash = (Get-FileHash -Path "SpaceCorps2027.zip" -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLower()
if ($hash -ne "d7aad21b4518ee299f2b91f05ecd5ffafca5bd51332bb93bca3e9cef399adb4f") { throw "Checksum mismatch" }
Expand-Archive -Path "SpaceCorps2027.zip" -DestinationPath "$HOME\SpaceCorps2027"
```

### Linux
```bash
curl -LO https://github.com/SpaceCorps/play/releases/latest/download/SpaceCorps2027-linux-x86_64.AppImage
echo "962206ce91663b9cddc4986e57b069a944554d1893e616e966dccb8be556fe23  SpaceCorps2027-linux-x86_64.AppImage" | sha256sum -c -
chmod +x SpaceCorps2027-linux-x86_64.AppImage
./SpaceCorps2027-linux-x86_64.AppImage
```

---

## Architecture & Configuration

- **Engine:** Space3d Engine (pure-Rust 3D rendering backend with Vulkan, Metal, DX12).
- **Default Game Server:** `https://spacecorps-game.sliplane.app`
- **Config Storage:**
  - Unix: `~/.spacecorps2027/`
  - Windows: `%USERPROFILE%\.spacecorps2027\`
- **Privacy Standard:** Zero telemetry, zero analytics tracking, zero third-party tracking cookies.
